objective: Confirm the exact compact rank-k CPU implementation against fresh refactorization with multi-seed, exclusive-node, single-thread timing.
timing_order: All six method permutations are repeated equally within every seed/rank/k cell.
timed_region: Prepared mutable state cloning is outside timing. Compact timing includes two triangular solves, rank-k correction, compact factor construction, factor update, and both operator applications. Fresh timing includes G and M rank-k updates, Cholesky factorization, and complete double-sided rewhitening.
correctness_reference: Fresh FP64 Cholesky factorization and double-sided whitening for the same G+ZZ^T and M+ZW^T.
statistical_unit: One independently generated problem seed; repeat-level timings are summarized within seed and are not pseudoreplicated.
primary_estimand: Within-seed fresh-refactorization median divided by compact-rank-k median, summarized across the ten seeds.
stopping_rule: Run every declared rank, k, and seed. Do not tune, filter, stop, or rerun based on confirmation outcomes.
